<includeonly><span class="nowrap">{{{1}}} ({{#ifexpr:{{{1}}}>=2|[[Health|<span class="mf-heart" role="img" aria-label="heart"></span>]] × {{#expr:{{{1}}}/2}}|[[Health|<span class="mf-heart mf-heart-half" role="img" aria-label="half a heart"></span>]] × 0.5}})</span></includeonly><noinclude>
Health points, shown as the pack's own HUD hearts, like the Minecraft Wiki's <code>hp</code> template. One heart is 2 health. <code><nowiki>{{Hp|8}}</nowiki></code> → {{Hp|8}}, <code><nowiki>{{Hp|1}}</nowiki></code> → {{Hp|1}}
